source_text: Subditus esto Domino et ora eum; noli aemulari in eo qui prosperatur in via sua. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Be subject to the Lord and pray to him; do not envy him who prospers in his way. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Be still before the Lord and wait for him; do not fret over one who prospers in his way >> Bible:Psalm 37:7]]. Glory to Christ. Amen.
